entities.name: Tallibeth Tarngold
entities.description: Daughter of Tagard Tarngold, human leader of the Valley of Tamingazin, who leads a rebellion to reclaim Berimish.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Human leader of the Valley of Tamingazin, father of Tallibeth, assassinated in the Betrayal of Tamingazin.

entities.name: Valley of Tamingazin
entities.description: Valley on Dominaria led by Tagard Tarngold.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: City taken in a bloodless coup by Tagard and later reclaimed by Talli.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Magician recruited by Tagard who later restored the Magewall.

entities.name: Recin
entities.description: Talli's Garan friend, sent to retrieve the Magewall Hub.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Tagard's general who seized power after the assassination and was killed by Talli.

entities.name: Lisolo
entities.description: Former Bey of Berimish recruited by Talli.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Lizard-like people who killed Talli's mother.

entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: The event in which Tagard was assassinated.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: Stolen device retrieved on Talli's order.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Forces Talli led the defense against.

events.summary: Talli travels with the procession to recruit Aligarius Timni and enters Berimish when her father takes it in a bloodless coup.
events.quote: entered Berimish when her father took the city in a bloodless coup

events.summary: Tagard is assassinated by Suderbod Ambassador Ursal Daleel and General Karelon seizes power.
events.quote: Tagard's general Karelon seized power in another coup

events.summary: Tallibeth recruits Lisolo and leads a rebellion to reclaim the city.
events.quote: Tallibeth recruited Lisolo , the former Bey of Berimish, and led a rebellion to reclaim the city

events.summary: Talli sends Recin to retrieve the Magewall Hub from Timni.
events.quote: Talli sent Recin on a mission to retrieve the stolen Magewall Hub from Timni

events.summary: Talli kills Karelon with a sword thrust.
events.quote: Talli killed the general with a sword thrust

events.summary: Talli leads the defense against the Suderbod forces until Timni restores the Magewall.
events.quote: Tallibeth then led the defense against the Suderbod forces

relations.quote: She was Tagard Tarngold 's only daughter.
Talli killed the general with a sword thrust
assassinated during the Betrayal of Tamingazin by Suderbod Ambassador Ursal Daleel
